responsibility: Strict data contracts for the sandboxed Electron Desktop renderer bootstrap, fixed six-port capability ordering, security attestation, application-lifetime control, and device-local terminal-launch-profile management.
nonGoals: Owning Electron Main, preload, renderer, Gateway, network, authentication, or transport lifecycle implementations.
Owning shared Workbench client-session, terminal projection, projected attachment, Workbench document, TerminalPresentation, PTY, VT, terminal process, or product-interface semantics.
Providing generic IPC, arbitrary Electron channels, compatibility aliases, or a protocol for ordinary Browser clients.
